 Adam Blevins began working in the entertainment industry in 2022 as a Staff Writer for Agents of Fandom, where he progressed to Senior Editor and interviewed talent from Marvel Studios , House of the Dragon , and Planet of the Apes . He joined Collider as a News Author in April 2024, was promoted to a Senior position in December 2024, and has written over 3,000 articles for the site, including exclusives relating to Avengers: Doomsday , The Penguin , Star Wars: Skeleton Crew , and more. He primarily writes about the latest box office numbers and the hottest movies and TV shows on streaming, while also covering superhero and sci-fi news.  Chris Pratt has been busy as ever in 2026 despite being years removed from his big-budget franchise roles, but that hasn’t stopped him from finding success at the box office. Pratt stumbled with the release of Mercy (co-starring Rebecca Ferguson ) earlier this year, but despite an underwhelming performance in theaters, the movie went on to find success on Prime Video . Pratt swiftly returned to box office greatness thanks to his titular role in The Super Mario Galaxy Movie , the sequel that grossed over $1 billion at the global box office. In the latter half of the year, Pratt has focused more on streaming projects like the second season of The Terminal List , which is now streaming on Prime Video. He’s soon to debut a new movie on Apple TV with Way of the Warrior Kid , which co-stars Linda Cardellini .

 Most fans would agree that, despite all the new roles he’s taken on in the last few years, Pratt is still best known for his role as Star-Lord in the Guardians of the Galaxy movies. All three films were written and directed by James Gunn , who was the co-head of DC Studios along with Peter Safran for several years before stepping down from his duties earlier in the week. Fans around the world are already asking about what James Gunn is going to do next, with some speculating that he could return to Marvel for another Guardians movie. During a recent interview with the Swedish outlet Moviezine to promote the second season of The Terminal List , Pratt was asked about potentially returning to the Marvel universe for a new Star-Lord project, possibly one even under James Gunn. His answer might shock you:

 Spider-Man 
 Queens, New York 
 Responsibility is not something you chose. It found you, and you never put it down. 
 You carry the weight of the world on shoulders younger than they should have to be: funny, loyal and endlessly self-sacrificing. You do the right thing not because it is easy but because nobody else will. Whether it is a mugging two streets over or a crisis across the multiverse, you show up. Great power demanding great responsibility is not a slogan to you. It is the code you live by, even when it costs you everything. 
 Why this is you 
 You show up for the small stuff nobody is watching.
 You joke through fear rather than letting it stop you.
 You take the loss personally, every time.

 Daredevil

 You looked into the dark and decided not to become it. That decision gets made again every night. 
 You fight in the space between law and chaos, steered by a moral compass that refuses to let the guilty walk. You use every tool you have, your mind, your body and your faith, to protect the people the system overlooks. You have come close to the edge and stepped back from it more than once. Matt Murdock's split, champion in the courtroom and devil in the alley, mirrors your own: relentless, conflicted and unwilling to stop. 
 Why this is you

 You hold a line you have genuinely wanted to cross.
 You take the cases nobody else will touch.

 Iron Man 
 Stark Industries, Malibu 
 You started out protecting yourself. Somewhere along the way the world became your problem. 
 Brilliant, driven and occasionally insufferable, but always the person who solves the unsolvable problem. You lead with your mind and back it with resources, invention and a stubbornness that edges into heroism. You began looking out for yourself and ended up carrying everyone else. Tony Stark's arc from ego to sacrifice is your arc too. You build, you plan, and when the moment comes you are willing to give everything. 
 Why this is you

 You would rather be useful than liked.

 The Punisher 
 New York City 
 What is left after the fire is not broken. It is narrowed down to one thing. 
 You went through something that would break most people, and it did change you, completely. What remains is unyielding and operates by a code forged in grief. You do not ask forgiveness and you do not expect thanks. You looked at a corrupt, broken world and decided to do something about it whatever it costs. Frank Castle's war comes out of love bent by loss, and so does yours. The world may never agree with your methods, but your conviction is absolute. 
 Why this is you 
 You finish what you start, with no appetite for ceremony.
 You keep your circle small and your mission smaller.
 You accept being the villain in somebody else's telling.

 Thor 
 Asgard, the Nine Realms 
 Worthiness is not a thing you are given. It is a thing you keep earning. 
 Powerful, proud, and on a long journey toward being worthy of the legend you carry. You lead with strength, and you learned, sometimes painfully, that the real thing comes from humility and growth instead. You are larger than life and more vulnerable than you let on. Thor's story is a long transformation, from arrogant prince to worthy king, from isolated warrior to someone people genuinely love. You bring the storm when it is needed and the warmth when that matters more. 
 Why this is you 
 You go first, and loudly.
 You take the lesson, eventually.
 You are the morale of the room as much as its muscle.

 Captain America 
 Brooklyn, New York 
 Strength was never the point. Refusing to move was the point. 
 You believe in something bigger than yourself, and you fight for it even once the world has moved on and nobody else will. You do not bully the small guy and you do not stop when it gets hard. Steve Rogers did not become a hero when he got the serum. He already was one, and so are you. Your strength is not in your fists, it is in refusing to compromise what is right whatever that costs. In a world of people taking the easy road, you are the one who stands back up. 
 Why this is you 
 You say the unpopular thing in the room where it costs you.
 You hold the plan together when it starts coming apart.
 You get back up. That is the whole trick.

 “That would be awesome. I love working with James [Gunn]. He’s the man. I haven’t had the chance to speak with him since that news came out… it's always tough because anytime something like this comes up it could always become a headline. All I’ll say is I love James. He directed all three [Guardians of the Galaxy movies], and that’s pretty rare… so if he wanted to come back and bring it back, I would love that.”
 Star-Lord Will Return To the MCU
 At the end of Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 , the card that played across the screen promised fans that “the legendary Star-Lord will return.” There’s been no official confirmation yet on which project will deliver on this promise, but most fans assume that Pratt will reprise the role in Avengers: Doomsday later this year. Still, Pratt told Collider last year that Marvel would follow through on the promise , so he certainly knows something that we don’t.
 Stay tuned to Collider for more updates and coverage of Chris Pratt’s future projects and check out the second season of The Terminal List on Prime Video.
